Recorded claim:
Cross-platform BCT failures converged on `TypeError: select.getListItems is not a function` at `moz-src:///toolkit/actors/SelectChild.sys.mjs:397`. The failing source checkout used Gecko `46d93393954cc9ac31ab056e4278dd027eb1a534` with `USE_ARTIFACT=1`, but installed a Gecko binary from `bca8737c308d0df876ae765300c906b76d0bb41c`. The newer revision has both `HTMLSelectElement.getListItems()` and the `SelectChild.sys.mjs` call; the older one has neither. [Task 1]
